stories.title: Tarik Skubal is a Dodger?! Grading the deadline's biggest blockbuster
stories.summary: Baseball's two-time defending champion adds a two-time Cy Young winner. L.A. gets an A -- but what about the Tigers?

stories.title: Sources: Dodgers win Skubal race, add Tigers ace
stories.summary: The first-place Los Angeles Dodgers finalized a trade to acquire two-time American League Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal, 29, from the Tigers, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Saturday, sending Zhyir Hope, River Ryan and Brady Smith to Detroit.

stories.title: Sources: Sparks deal All-Star G Plum to Mercury
stories.summary: The Sparks are trading five-time All-Star Kelsey Plum to the Mercury for Monique Akoa Makani, a 2027 first-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: White Sox land Castillo in trade with Mariners
stories.summary: The White Sox are acquiring right-handed pitcher Luis Castillo from the Mariners for Seranthony Dominguez, Nolan Jones and prospect Boston Smith.

stories.title: 49ers' Pearsall to have season-ending surgery
stories.summary: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Ricky Pearsall is expected to have surgery on the nagging PCL injury that dates back to last season and will be out for the year, general manager John Lynch told reporters.
